name: cronjob
description: Scheduled prompts: recurring jobs ("every 30m", "daily 07:30") and one-shot wake-ups ("in 20m", "at 18:30"). Personal schedules run with their owner's rights and return to the originating one-person conversation; instance automation runs with owner powers and reports through the notification channel.

configSchema.label: Scheduler
configSchema.hint: Tick interval, retry behavior and the guard check timeout.

configSchema.label: Tick interval (ms)
configSchema.hint: How often due jobs are checked.

configSchema.label: Turn attempts
configSchema.hint: Total attempts for a recurring job's turn on a transient request-time failure — 1 means no retry, 2 (the default) means one retry.

configSchema.label: Retry backoff (ms)
configSchema.hint: Pause before a retry so the transient condition can clear.

configSchema.label: Check timeout (ms)
configSchema.hint: Timeout for a job's cheap guard `check` command.

configSchema.label: Check output limit (chars)
configSchema.hint: How much of a guard `check`'s output is fed into the brain turn. Raise it for collectors that emit large aggregated data.

configSchema.label: Cron catch-up window (ms)
configSchema.hint: How far back a 5-field cron job looks for a run it missed while the daemon was down. Only the most recent missed occurrence is replayed, never a backlog. Range 1 hour to 7 days, default 24 hours.

configSchema.label: Fresh-session idle threshold (ms)
configSchema.hint: Optional. A job idle longer than this between runs starts a fresh conversation on its next tick — past the model's prompt-cache window, reusing the old context is pure cost with no cache benefit. Leave empty to use the host default (like Discord). Set a smaller value for frequent jobs, a larger one to keep continuity longer, or 0 to never start fresh (always keep the running context).

configSchema.label: Per-account limits
configSchema.hint: Ceilings on what one account may schedule personally. Instance jobs are not limited.

configSchema.label: Jobs per account
configSchema.hint: How many scheduled jobs one non-admin account may keep at a time.

configSchema.label: Shortest interval (minutes)
configSchema.hint: The fastest recurring schedule a non-admin account may set. Every fire is a model call the operator pays for.

strings.title: Automation
strings.sectionHint: Recurring prompts run on schedule. Changes apply within 30 seconds.
strings.deleteDesc: The job “{name}” will be removed permanently.
strings.name: Name
strings.helpSchedule: Use the builder for interval, daily or weekly schedules. Advanced mode preserves raw five-field cron expressions and existing values the builder does not represent.
strings.scheduleAdvancedHint: Enter a valid five-field cron expression. An existing unsupported value is preserved until you edit it.
strings.helpHours: Optional whole-hour window from 0 to 23. Overnight windows such as 22-5 are supported; minutes are not.
strings.hoursLegacyHint: This stored value is not an H-H whole-hour window and will remain unchanged until you choose another mode:
strings.helpHeader: On = the delivered message starts with a "⏰ job name" line. Turn off for persona messages in a dedicated channel.
strings.helpCheck: Cheap shell guard before the prompt. No output = AI turn is skipped (saves a model call); output is passed to the assistant.
strings.helpPrompt: What the assistant does on each run.
strings.helpChannel: Where the result is delivered on Discord. Default = the discord plugin’s notification channel.
strings.helpModel: Which model the job runs on. Default = the server default model.
strings.ownerFieldHint: An instance job runs without an account and reports to its notification channel. Handing it to yourself makes it run with your permissions and report in your own conversation.
